title: Vesper and the Static
author: C. M. Montrose
blurb: Gideon Brightwater, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
